This is my own land, near the city, and I grow a mix of crops together on it. Fertilizer and sprays cost too much for me, and these crops I plant do not need them — I save seed from last season like my neighbors do. The rains come twice here so I do not need to water the field. My family works hard on this land but it is big, so I will pay a few people to help me clear and weed during the busy times.
